root_cause: The ARM64 cross-compilation build's precompiled header for the openvino_shape_inference target (cmake_pch.hxx.gch) is rejected by cc1plus as 'not a PCH file', which becomes a hard failure under -Werror -Winvalid-pch. This is the same recurring signature previously recorded for PR #37942 (run 36069429763, 2026-09-24T23:04:41Z), now recurring on PR #38393 (a GPU-only memory-dependency change touching only src/plugins/intel_gpu/*), confirming the failure is unrelated to the specific PR's diff and is instead an infrastructure/caching artifact affecting the openvino_shape_inference PCH generation on the ARM64 cross-compilation runner (likely a stale/incompatible sccache- or build-dir-restored .gch reused across incompatible compiler/flag states).
reproduction_steps: N/A (depends on a stale/corrupted cmake_pch.hxx.gch artifact reused between CI runs on the ARM64 cross-compilation runner's build cache; not reliably reproducible outside that CI container/cache state). Locally, one can approximate it by reusing a cmake_pch.hxx.gch produced by a different compiler/flags combination and rebuilding openvino_shape_inference with -Werror -Winvalid-pch.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed 'Build / Build' job — a clean CMake/ninja build regenerates cmake_pch.hxx.gch and should clear the stale/corrupted PCH.

Since this signature has now recurred across two unrelated PRs (#37942 and #38393), invalidate/clear the sccache and build-dir caches used by the ARM64 cross-compilation job to remove the incompatible cached PCH at the source.

Audit the PCH cache key for the openvino_shape_inference target to ensure it is tied to the exact compiler version, target flags (e.g. -std=c++17, visibility flags), and toolchain (aarch64-linux-gnu-g++) so a partially-restored/cross-job cache cannot supply an incompatible .gch.
No code change is required in PR #38393; the GPU-only diff (oooq_memory_dependencies.cpp and its unit test) does not touch src/core/shape_inference.
prevention_strategies: Key PCH artifacts to the exact compiler version, flags, and toolchain used to generate them so a partially-restored or cross-job cache cannot mix an incompatible .gch. Consider a build step that removes stale *.gch files before a fresh CMake configure whenever the compiler/flags might have changed, or add automatic PCH regeneration instead of hard-failing on -Werror=invalid-pch.
historical_context: This is the second recorded occurrence of this exact signature in the merge-queue knowledge base (pattern 5b4b1e6917a69856, count now 2). It was first seen 2026-09-24T23:04:41Z on run 36069429763 / PR #37942 with an identical root cause (GCC PCH validation failure for openvino_shape_inference under -Werror=invalid-pch), also unrelated to that PR's NPU-only diff. Recurrence across two unrelated PRs within ~10 hours strengthens the infrastructure/caching hypothesis over a code-level cause.
